clips.title: The story
paras: Magistrate Sevren of Brill tasks adventurers with purging Rot Hide gnolls from the Mass Grave southwest of Garren's Haunt. These undead beasts were sent by the Scourge to dig up the corpses of early plague victims to swell their ranks. Slaying them and recovering their embalming ichor protects the fallen and aids the Royal Apothecary Society's research.

When the Plague of Undeath first tore through Tirisfal Glades, the dead piled up faster than formal burials could accommodate. Immense mass graves were dug across the north to contain the staggering loss. Until recently, those buried remains escaped resurrection. Now, however, the Scourge has unleashed Rot Hide gnolls upon the trenches southwest of Garren's Haunt, sending them to exhumate the decayed remains to reinforce the Lich King's armies.

The Rot Hides are sustained by embalming ichor, an alchemical concoction that preserves and animates their rotting frames. By commanding scouts to slay the graverobbers and extract this fluid, Magistrate Sevren strikes two blows at once: halting the Scourge's harvest of raw bodies and delivering valuable biological specimens directly to the apothecaries in Brill, who seek to turn the Lich King's own craft against him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.
The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies. This cannot be allowed!
Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is your task complete? Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Expertly done, friend. The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries. It may have secrets we can use against them.
As I said, well done. But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
